verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has automation-like features (alert rules and uptime monitors), so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back those automations is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no version history, review flow, or rollback for alerts or monitors. Its release and deploy CLI commands track versions of the user's own application, not of GlitchTip automations, so they are a different capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
